overview.title: Overview

setup.members_hint: Who pays and who spends: each member can own accounts and cards.
setup.accounts_hint: Current, savings and credit accounts with their opening balances.
setup.categories_hint: Start from the suggested list (groceries, housing, kids…) and adjust it.
setup.budget_hint: An amount per category; the overview compares it with what was spent.

planned.title: Coming soon
planned.transactions: Every income and expense, from all accounts and cards, with categories, members and notes.
planned.budget: Monthly and yearly plan per category, compared with what was actually spent.
planned.accounts: Bank accounts, cards and cash with their balances.
planned.recurring: Subscriptions, bills and yearly charges (insurance, taxes) with reminders before they are due.
planned.debts: Loans, instalments and money owed, with what is left to pay and the payoff date.
planned.projections: Where the balance is heading: planned income, bills and instalments over the coming months.
planned.reports: Spending by category, member and month, and how this year compares with last year.

welcome.title: Welcome to Home Budget
welcome.body: Your household money in one place: what came in, what went out, what is left this month and what is coming. Here is where everything lives.

overview.title: $t(nav.overview)
overview.body: Start here every time: this month's income, expenses, what is left to spend and the bills coming up.

transactions.title: $t(nav.transactions)
transactions.body: Coming soon: every income and expense from all accounts and cards, quick to add and easy to filter.

budget.title: $t(nav.budget)
budget.body: Coming soon: an amount per category for the month and the year, compared with what was actually spent.

accounts.title: $t(nav.accounts)
accounts.body: Coming soon: bank accounts, cards and cash with their balances.

recurring.title: $t(nav.recurring)
recurring.body: Coming soon: subscriptions, bills and yearly charges, with a reminder before each one is due.

debts.title: $t(nav.debts)
debts.body: Coming soon: loans and instalments, with what is left to pay and when it ends.

insight.title: $t(nav.projections) · $t(nav.reports)
insight.body: Coming soon: where the balance is heading, and where the money went by category, member and month.

settings.title: $t(nav.settings)
settings.body: Theme, language, date format and the data folder. You can replay this tour from here.

search.title: Find anything
search.body: Press Ctrl+K to jump to any page or run a command, such as switching theme or printing a budget worksheet.

portable.badge_hint: Portable edition: data is kept next to the app, on this drive
portable.data_hint: Everything is saved next to the app, so it travels with the drive. A copy is kept in backups/ each time the app starts.

worksheet.button_hint: A blank monthly budget sheet to plan on paper (PDF)
worksheet.title: Budget · {{month}}
worksheet.subtitle: Monthly budget worksheet · printed {{date}}
worksheet.footnote: Write the planned amount at the start of the month and the actual amount at the end. Difference = planned − actual: a negative number means you spent more than planned. Use the empty rows for your own categories.

pdf.preview_hint: This is what the PDF will look like.
